papers.what_it_is: A review of unsupervised feature learning and deep learning covering probabilistic models, auto-encoders, manifold learning and deep networks, with open questions on objectives, inference and geometry.

assertions.value: The authors hypothesize that the success of machine learning algorithms generally depends on data representation because different representations can entangle and hide more or less the different explanatory factors of variation behind the data.
quotes: we hypothesize that this is because different representations can entangle and hide more or less the different explanatory factors of variation behind the data
assertions.certainty_reason: An author's claim in a review; the paper gives no experiment or proof for it here.

assertions.value: The authors state that the paper reviews recent work in unsupervised feature learning and deep learning, covering advances in probabilistic models, auto-encoders, manifold learning, and deep networks.
quotes: This paper reviews recent work in the area of unsupervised feature learning and deep learning, covering advances in probabilistic models, auto-encoders, manifold learning, and deep networks.
assertions.certainty_reason: The paper states its own scope at the cited place.

assertions.value: The authors define representation learning as learning representations of the data that make it easier to extract useful information when building classifiers or other predictors.
quotes: This paper is about representation learning, i.e., learning representations of the data that make it easier to extract useful information when building classifiers or other predictors.
assertions.certainty_reason: The paper states its own definition or description at the cited place.

assertions.certainty_reason: The paper states its own scope at the cited place.

assertions.value: The authors state that feature engineering is important but labor-intensive and highlights the weakness of current learning algorithms: their inability to extract and organize the discriminative information from the data.
